# 2. Code Evidence

Entry authenticated at HEAD `64cf75ddc215009273713c08165b1058fef8b424`,
tree `87773ea9260b80a03dc2c2555606ecc2db9a8a6e`, subject
`G77-256KN fail closed at exact Human source authentication`, and equal remote
branch head. Stable anchor `5c972e9960987ab27420395b54ace693df097e7b`
is an ancestor. The nested authority is clean and detached at
`3183bab71f8f30397c0309dd2e6d846d14a11f66`, tree
`7c32ec05efc2be43297849bc38ec8766514a523d`, with remote-tag equality.

The existing protocol evidence authenticates:

- owner: direct Human act at the generation-local source boundary, validated
  by the existing Phase-B controller chain;
- artifact: exact UTF-8, LF-terminated generation-local text file;
- capture: the Human personally creates the file after presentation; no
  repository controller writes it;
- bytes: raw equality to the presented act and SHA-256 derived from those
  bytes, never accepted from caller/provider input;
- provenance: source absent at the pre-Human barrier and AI writing forbidden;
- presentation: exact generation, operation, candidate, presentation hash,
  scope, limits, and exclusions appear in the source act;
- temporal rule: source appears only after presentation and is revalidated
  against unchanged KN coordinates before binding;
- handoff: the derived source digest is bound through canonical FM authority
  handoff and JZ preconsumption validation;
- consumption: collision-guarded, exactly once, nonreusable, nontransferable,
  with no retry or replay.

The exact direct action is presented in
`G77_256KO_DIRECT_HUMAN_ACT_INSTRUCTION_V1.txt`. That instruction is
nonauthority. The required KN source path remains absent.
